decisions.text: The energy source will be kinetic energy.
The case material will be rubber.
The LEDs behind the buttons match the button color.
The flipping mechanism was removed from the design.
The product name is 'Real Remote' with a copyright symbol.

notes:
## Product Requirements and Aesthetics
- Target audience is young people and children, requiring a fancy look, technological feel, and ease of use.
- The device should have a 'fruit and vegetable' aesthetic with bright colors and a spongy feel.
- The case material was chosen to be rubber to make the device safe and durable for throwing.
## Power and Electronics
- The energy source will be kinetic energy instead of batteries, as it is more long-lasting and fun.
- An advanced chip will be used to support screen and audio functions.
## Design and Safety
- The background color is green with red buttons to provide good contrast and visibility for colorblind users.
- The LEDs behind the buttons match the button color to provide extra light and feedback.
- The flipping mechanism was removed from the design because the device would break if dropped and the screen is too low when flipped.
## Controls and Layout
- The device will have side buttons for volume and scrolling menus as a futuristic alternative to standard arrow buttons.
- The design should accommodate both left-handed and right-handed users.
tldr: The team designed a new remote control named 'Real Remote' targeting children and non-experts. They settled on a green background with red buttons and a spongy rubber case powered by kinetic energy. After rejecting a flipping screen mechanism for safety reasons, they agreed to finalize the design with side buttons for volume and scrolling.
